svg.title: Latency hiding with multiple warps
svg.text: Latency hiding: why GPUs keep many warps per SM
Each warp repeats: one load (20-cycle memory latency) then 4 arithmetic instructions that need it. The scheduler issues one instruction per cycle.
waiting on memory (the SM can run another warp)
Pixelstorm today stalls the whole SM during MEM, like the 1-warp row. Exercise 2 in docs/12 makes it behave like the 4-warp row. Try it live in web/labs.html.
